levels.surface: أبو يزيد محمد بن يحيى بن خالد (4) بن يزيد المروزي

notes: Narrated encounter: Ibn Masʿud is named as the place («عند عبد الله بن مسعود») and then speaks («قال: إنك لحدث السن»), so he is the last link (owner ruling 5); the youth who asks is in the scene, not a link.
The footnote number «(4)» stays inside its surface as written; «(1)» after هشام is left out; the gloss «وهو المعروف بإسحاق بن راهويه» and the dates are left out.
